name: ACMG_overlay_gate_assess_variant
description: Executable front-door ACMG overlay harness for germline variant pathogenicity assessment. Use mode=assess to perform the ACMG-gated assessment before GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, SpliceAI, MyVariant, VEP, gnomAD, MaveDB, ClinGen/G2P, or other direct evidence tools when the user asks for ACMG classification, pathogenicity, clinical significance, VUS/Benign/Pathogenic five-tier output, or germline variant interpretation. This tool is not an ACMG classifier; it orchestrates existing ToolUniverse evidence tools, records coverage, normalizes direct outputs as source leads, produces an acmg_assessment_bundle, runs the strict validator, and tells whether final classification is allowed. Do not manually combine GeneBe, ClinVar, SpliceAI, or literature outputs into ACMG criteria outside this harness. Use mode=plan_only for preflight only and mode=validate_bundle to validate a supplied bundle. Final ACMG/pathogenicity wording requires actual literature coverage and validator_status: PASS.

variant.description: Variant identifier or HGVS expression, e.g. NM_000142.5:c.1075+95C>G or chr4:1803931C>G. Required for mode=assess; optional for mode=validate_bundle when the bundle already contains variant context.

transcript.description: Transcript accession or transcript context, if known.

consequence.description: Known or suspected consequence such as missense_variant, splice_region_variant, frameshift_variant, in-frame insertion, etc.

variant_type.description: Variant type summary if consequence is not available.

disease_context.description: Disease, inheritance, mechanism, or VCEP context supplied by the user or previous tools.

phenotype_context.description: Patient or cohort phenotype context, including HPO terms or clinical description.

family_context.description: Family, segregation, de novo, phase, or affected-relative context.

source_outputs_or_leads.description: Existing outputs from GeneBe, InterVar, ClinVar, ClinGen, SpliceAI, MyVariant, VEP, papers, labs, or other tools. These are normalized as source leads, not counted evidence.

acmg_assessment_bundle.description: Optional machine-checkable assessment bundle to validate with the overlay gate validator.

output_mode.description: Use compact for concise CLI/agent output. Use full to include the full acmg_assessment_bundle skeleton and full route rows.

mode.description: assess runs the executable ACMG harness; plan_only returns preflight guidance only; validate_bundle only validates a supplied acmg_assessment_bundle.

required_baseline_routes.description: Full output only: complete baseline route rows.

triggered_discovery_routes.description: Full output only: complete triggered discovery route rows.

online_literature_query_templates.description: Full output only: detailed query templates.

required_coverage_tasks.description: Full output only: expanded coverage task details.

acmg_assessment_bundle.description: Full output only: bundle skeleton or supplied bundle.

required_baseline_route_groups.description: Deprecated compact field; route groups are now full-output only.

triggered_discovery_route_groups.description: Deprecated compact field; route groups are now full-output only.

tool_calls.description: Full output only: executed harness tool calls and statuses.

coverage_audit.description: Full output only: generated coverage audit rows.

overlay_results.description: Full output only: generated overlay result rows.

route_audit.description: Full output only: generated route audit rows.
